{{Quote|Hunter Lead here, anyone need help?|Corran Horn|<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
'''Hunter Lead''', also known as '''Hunt Leader''', was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] given to the leader of the ersatz [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] formed by five members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during their [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|infiltration]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] served as Hunter Lead in a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], but sabotage conducted by fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Erisi Dlarit]], who was in fact an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], caused Horn to crash and become [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in [[Lusankya (prison)|Lusankya]].
